summary: iter241 frontend verification: Install-App button always visible + Theme toggle (light/dark) with localStorage persistence on client dashboard, admin panel, and mobile menu. All flows PASS.

design_issues.screen: Light mode - all reviewed views (/dashboard, /dashboard/assets, /dashboard/marketplace + redeem dialog, /admin, /admin/inventory Control, /admin/users, /admin/withdrawals, mobile menu)
issues: No readability issues detected. Body bg rgb(244,242,250) with dark text (#1b1626). Tables, inputs, badges (NO VERIFICADO, BAJO/OK), dialogs, and sidebars all render with adequate contrast. Screenshots captured OK.

verified_flows: Cliente /dashboard: logout-btn-install-app visible=True in sidebar footer even without native beforeinstallprompt (headless).
Click logout-btn-install-app -> install-generic-help-dialog opens (visible=True) with Android + PC instructions.
install-generic-help-close closes the dialog (visible after close = False).
dashboard-theme-toggle: dark -> light adds 'light' class on <html> and sets localStorage.rb_theme='light'.
Admin /admin: admin-install-app and admin-theme-toggle visible in footer; theme persisted across role/route change (light stayed True on admin views).
Mobile viewport 390x844: dashboard-mobile-menu-trigger opens sheet showing logout-mobile-btn-install-app and a theme-toggle in the footer.
Final restoration: toggling back sets html without 'light' class and localStorage.rb_theme='dark'. Theme left in DARK as requested.
console_warnings_observed: Warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent} — accessibility warning on some dialogs (mobile menu SheetContent and marketplace dialog). Minor a11y improvement, not blocking.
Encountered two children with the same key on /admin/inventory — pre-existing (iter238-era), not related to iter241.
SW fetchBuildId Failed to fetch — pre-existing service worker warning, non-blocking.
action_items: (Optional) Add `aria-describedby` / DialogDescription to the mobile menu SheetContent and marketplace redeem dialog to silence Radix a11y warnings.
(Optional, unrelated to iter241) Fix duplicate React keys warning in /admin/inventory list.
critical_code_review_comments: InstallAppButton correctly falls back to generic dialog when neither canInstall nor iOS — matches iter241 spec.
theme.js applies class only at setTheme; initial applyTheme should also run on app boot (assumed to be wired in App.jsx via applyTheme(getTheme()) — verified via reload persistence test).

index.css html.light overrides cover common tailwind bg/text/border tokens; observed views all render legibly. Consider adding a `.light` variant for hardcoded green/red badge backgrounds if any future badges rely on very light neutrals — none observed currently.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter241 (PWA install button always visible + theme toggle with rb_theme localStorage) fully verified via Playwright against preview URL. Final theme restored to dark. No regressions found in critical light-mode views.
